{{SeriesInformation
|title = ''[[The Wheel of Time]]''
|author = [[Robert Jordan]], [[Brandon Sanderson]]
|release = January 15, 1990
|genre = Fantasy
|pages = 12,529 spread across fourteen books and a prequel
|description = In an [[Age]] long past, an Age yet to come, the [[Dragon Reborn]] rides on the winds of time.  He rides to [[Tarmon Gai'don]], the Last Battle, to seal the [[Dark One]] back in his prison.  But in his fight, he may yet destroy the world.
|characters = [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Perrin Aybara]], [[Matrim Cauthon]], [[Aviendha]], [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Min Farshaw]], [[Faile ni Bashere t'Aybara]], [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]], [[Loial]]
|book series = [[w:c:lordoftherings|''The Lord of The Rings'']], [[w:c:stormlightarchive|''The Stormlight Archive'']], [[w:c:darktower|''The Dark Tower'']], [[w:c:malazan|''Malazan Book of the Fallen'']], [[w:c:harrypotter|''Harry Potter'']]
|rating = Young Adult - Adult
|violence = Fantasy and medieval-style fighting scenes.  A few instances of maiming and/or torture.
|language = No profane language. All "swearing" is made-up and uses no real-world words. See [[Swearing and Insults]] for examples.
|sexual-themes = No overt or explicit sexual content.  A few interspersed innuendos. A small number of "lead-ups" that soon cut to a later time. 
|drugs-alcohol = Ale, wine, brandy, and "[[oosquai]]" are featured throughout the series, and most uses are fairly benign.  Only a few instances of drunkenness depicted. 
|crude-humor = A number of instances of comic mischief early on.
}}
